entities.summary: Maria do Rosário Valente Rebelo Pinto Palma Ramalho is a Portuguese professor of law, and politician. She has been Minister of Labour, Solidarity and Social Security since 2024, in the XXIV Constitutional Government, led by Luís Montenegro.
